summary: Undo and redo stack. A new action after undoing clears the redo future.
overview: Execute runs a command immediately and records it; Undo and Redo walk back and forth. A fresh Execute after undoing clears the redo stack — the standard rule every undo system follows, because the old future no longer applies.
useCases: A level or map editor's undo.
Any tool where a mistake should be reversible.

params.tuning: The oldest is discarded past this. Commands holding large data (a whole texture) make this a memory decision, not just a convenience one.

gotchas.title: Only what you route through it can be undone
gotchas.body: Changing state directly is invisible to the stack and leaves undo doing something inconsistent.
